description: Recommend one outing and a distinct sheltered backup when evidence and constraints allow. Requires complete party. Filters remain strict; editorial suitability must fit every child. visit_date records intent only: opening, reservations and availability remain unverified. No travel-time or whole-outing-budget support. Return shortages honestly. No booking is performed.

include_kidpaths_resources.description: Plan only. Set only when the family explicitly asks for a printable or offline city guide, or for a weekly email of outing ideas. Returns KidPaths' own resources for guide cities, labeled as such; some hosts never receive them.

visit_date.description: Plan only. Requested date, not verified opening or availability.
